title: Inventory maternal-newborn Chagas cascade data sources
outcome: A dated source inventory and measure dictionary separating maternal screening, diagnosis, newborn testing, infant treatment, and follow-up.
expected_artifact: datasets.md update plus evidence.json records for each accepted source family.
validation_method: Domain reviewer checks each source for event grain, denominator, timing, coverage, access status, and explicit limitations.
done_condition: At least six candidate source families are classified as usable, limited, or rejected, with explicit reasons covering numerator, denominator, test timing, linkage, migration, and follow-up.

title: Define a country-level congenital Chagas cascade baseline
outcome: A reproducible baseline specification for the five cascade stages and their missingness rules.
expected_artifact: validation.md update with a stage-level data dictionary and exclusion rules.
validation_method: Replicator runs the specification on a de-identified sample and confirms every numerator, denominator, exclusion, and missingness category.
done_condition: A reviewer can reconstruct each cascade stage from a de-identified sample without treating policy, procurement, or dispensing as completed treatment.

title: Audit linkage and missingness in Chagas maternal-newborn records
outcome: A documented audit of duplicate tests, unmatched maternal-infant records, timing gaps, private-sector omissions, and migration-related loss to follow-up.
validation_method: Replicator reruns duplicate, match-rate, timing-window, and missingness calculations from the documented input hash and environment.
done_condition: The audit reports match rates and missingness by cascade stage and shows how at least one plausible linkage failure changes the estimated bottleneck.

title: Red-team stigma and misuse risks in cascade outputs
outcome: A failure-mode review covering stigma, coercive screening, migrant exclusion, facility blame, privacy loss, and clinical overreach.
validation_method: Red-team reviewer documents concrete misuse paths and a second reviewer independently replicates the failure-mode check, confirming that each has a mitigation or publication block.
done_condition: Every proposed public-facing output is either blocked or has named safeguards for stigma, privacy, coercion, denominator error, and clinical misinterpretation.

title: Test the cascade output against a real program decision
outcome: A field-facing review that names the responsible program user, decision, timing, data burden, appeal path, and non-use cases.
validation_method: Field-reality reviewer records the decision workflow and a second reviewer independently replicates the check that the output does not bypass clinical or privacy governance.
done_condition: A named program decision-maker can identify one responsible use, one explicit non-use, and the minimum evidence needed before acting on the output.
